name: Itou Sakura
source:
Sakura loves to see things clean and neat — as the Chairwoman of the Beautification Committee, she picks up trash around the school every day. Sakura abides by [url=/c98214]Reika[/url]'s will, following her alongside [url=/c98574]Kaede[/url]. Kaede and Sakura are called the Springfall Duo. Whenever Sakura lets her hair down and takes off her glasses, she is considered to be unrecognizable and extremely beautiful.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
